display_long_description:
Discover how sea level rise and powerful storms could shape the future of Santa Cruz — and explore how nature can help protect our coast.

In this interactive app, you’ll join Otter 841, the famous surfboard-stealing otter turned storyteller, on a playful yet eye-opening journey along the Santa Cruz shoreline. From Steamer Lane to Main Beach, Its Beach, and Mitchell’s Cove, you’ll witness flooding, erosion, and coastal change — then test out living shorelines and nature-based solutions that can keep beaches, wildlife, and neighborhoods safe.

✨ What you’ll experience:

Immersive 360° visuals of Santa Cruz’s iconic coast

Interactive tools to explore storm and sea level rise impacts

Nature-based solutions like dunes, reefs, tidepools, and marshes

A unique perspective from Otter 841, your fun and fearless guide

Whether you’re a student, community member, or simply curious about coastal resilience, this app brings the future of Santa Cruz to life in an unforgettable way.

Let’s ride the waves of change — and protect the coast together. 🌊🦦
